v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Primum quidem sermónem feci de ómnibus, o Theóphile, quæ cœpit Iesus fácere et docére usque in diem, qua præcípiens Apóstolis per Spíritum Sanctum, quos elégit, assúmptus est.
text.en: The former treatise I made, O Theophilus, of all things which Jesus began to do and to teach, Until the day on which, giving commandments by the Holy Ghost to the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up.

text.la: Ascéndo ad Patrem meum, * et Patrem vestrum: Deum meum, et Deum vestrum, allelúia.
text.en: I ascend to my Father * and to your Father: to my God and your God, alleluia.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui hodiérna die Unigénitum tuum, Redemptórem nostrum, ad cælos ascendísse crédimus; ipsi quoque mente in cæléstibus habitémus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that just as we do believe thine Only-Begotten Son, our Saviour, to have this day ascended into the heavens, so we may also in heart and mind thither ascend, and with Him continually dwell.

text.la: Fíliæ Ierúsalem, veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Daughters of Jerusalem, come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui beáti Bonifátii Mártyris tui solémnia cólimus, eius apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who do make solemn remembrance of thine holy Martyr, Boniface, may be helped in thy presence by his prayers.

office.title: Feria VI infra Hebd post Ascensionem
